artist.name: shy martin
artist.short_description: Swedish singer-songwriter whose emotionally candid pop blends polished hooks, personal storytelling, and collaborations with electronic producers.
artist.biography:
SHY Martin is the performing name of Sara Hjellström, a Swedish singer-songwriter raised in Lerdala, a small town in southern Sweden. She began making music at a young age, playing guitar and joining a band before studying songwriting at Musikmakarna in northern Sweden. Her career developed first behind the scenes: she co-wrote and performed on Mike Perry’s 2016 single “The Ocean” and contributed to songs associated with The Chainsmokers and other international pop artists.

Her own releases took shape in the late 2010s. The EP “Overthinking” arrived in 2018, followed by “Sad Songs” in 2020. In a first-person track-by-track account of “Sad Songs,” she described material drawn from broken relationships, the loss of friendship and her experiences with anxiety. The EP balances confessional subjects with polished pop songwriting.

After stepping back from a broader industry-writing routine, she returned with “wish I didn’t know you” in 2022, describing that bedroom-written song as a way back to enjoying music-making. Her debut full-length album, “late night thoughts,” followed in May 2023. In interviews, she characterized the album as a more personal project exploring emotional strain and other experiences she had previously struggled to address. The result spans intimate songwriting and accessible contemporary pop without reducing her work to a single mood.
